reason: The supplied scores vary widely and have no paired controls, so they do not establish that any proposal improves performance. I ranked localized changes with direct checks first, then changes with greater scheduling or traversal risk, and packing changes that add work inside the timed call later. `assembly_audit` and `vector_access` propose nearly the same post-indexed load change; test them separately to avoid treating a joint result as evidence for either one. `tail_alignment` affects only the fallback, so it has little expected effect on the fixed n=512 score.
